summary: Long-established history held up, from Richfield and Stokes to Bone Thugs and the Rocket Arena rename, and the dossiers match current facts on roster, coach, Cup group and MLK Day. Three live checks found real errors: two closed restaurants in food and a missed WNBA expansion team in hoops. The strategy brief still needs the editor fixes below, and the Cavs hex values disagree across dossiers.
